# The secret merge driver stages decrypted plaintext under .sesam/tmp. That
# directory must be git-ignored so a crashed/interrupted merge can never leave
# plaintext that a later `git add .sesam` would commit into history.

exec git init
exec git config user.email test@sesam.dev
exec git config user.name 'Sesam Test'

exec sesam init --user admin
exec git add -A
exec git commit -m 'init sesam'

# check-ignore exits 0 and echoes the path when it is ignored.
exec git check-ignore .sesam/tmp/secret.txt.ours
stdout '\.sesam/tmp'
